lg_cover: Early 2000s, a lone executive seen from behind stands at a tall window of a low brick-and-glass headquarters in a small Danish town at dusk. On the desk behind, a huge loose pile of colourful plastic building bricks next to a stack of unpaid-looking paper ledgers and a beige desktop computer with a CRT monitor. A mood of a proud company at the edge. Cinematic editorial photograph, natural light, shallow depth of field, slightly muted colours. No faces visible, no logos, no readable text.
